item.title: Schuylkill Transportation System Announces Closure Due to Weather Forecast
item.description: The Schuylkill Transportation System (STS) has announced it will be closed on Monday, February 23, 2026, due to the anticipated winter weather. In a service alert issued Sunday, officials said all STS transportation services will be suspended for the day as a precaution in response to the forecasted storm conditions.

item.title: Joe Gerchak Honored for 50 Seasons as PIAA Official
item.description: The local high school basketball community came together Friday night for a special tribute prior to the Schuylkill League Girls Basketball Championship, honoring one of the area’s most respected figures in scholastic athletics. Veteran official Joe Gerchak was recognized before the championship game at Martz Hall for completing his 50th season as a basketball official under the Pennsylvania Interscholastic Athletic Association (PIAA), a milestone few reach in the sport.
